app.name: Amazon Q Developer
app.description:
# Ô£¿ **Amazon Q Developer** - Your AI-Powered Developer Assistant!

Supercharge your development workflow with Amazon Q Developer, the generative AI assistant that transforms how you code! Through seamless GitHub integration, Amazon Q Developer accelerates your daily tasks by automating feature development, code reviews, testing, documentation, and bug fixes ÔÇö all conveniently managed through GitHub issues and pull requests.

Get started for free, with no AWS account required! By installing, you agree to the [AWS Customer Agreement](https://aws.amazon.com/agreement/), [AWS Service Terms](https://aws.amazon.com/service-terms/), and [AWS Privacy Notice](https://aws.amazon.com/privacy/).

# ­ƒÜÇ **Accelerate Your Development**

| Feature | Capabilities | Activation |
|---------|--------------------------------|------------|
| ­ƒÆ╗ Feature Development | Turn ideas into code in minutes! Quickly build features, debug issues, generate tests, create documentation, and optimize algorithms using simple natural language. | Apply Amazon Q development agent label or use `/q dev` command in issue comment. |
| ­ƒöì Code Review | Ship better code faster! Get instant, intelligent feedback on your pull requests to improve quality and catch issues before they reach production. | Automatic for new/reopened PRs or use `/q review` command in PR comment. |

# ­ƒøá´©Å Custom Project Rules

Tailor Amazon Q to your team's needs! Define custom coding standards in simple Markdown files in the `project-root/.amazonq/rules` directory. Amazon Q automatically follows your guidelines, ensuring consistent code quality across your entire project. [Learn more](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazonq/latest/qdeveloper-ug/project-rules.html).

# ­ƒÅü Quick Start Guide

1. [**Install**](https://github.com/marketplace/amazon-q-developer) Amazon Q Developer from the GitHub Marketplace in seconds.
2. **Activate** by adding the **Amazon Q development** agent label to issues, or let it automatically review your PRs. Need help? Just type `/q help` in any comment!
3. **Boost limits** (optional): [Register with your AWS account](https://us-east-1.console.aws.amazon.com/amazonq/developer/home?region=us-east-1#/github/register) for even more productivity power.

# ­ƒöï Browser Extensions

Work even faster with our browser extensions that add a dedicated Amazon Q button directly to your GitHub issues! No more searching for labels - just click and accelerate:

[Chrome](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/amazon-q-github-issue-hel/oefafjbablenakmhacfllkmpaeabnnfi) | [Firefox](https://addons.mozilla.org/en-US/firefox/addon/amazon-q-github-issue-helper/) | [Edge](https://microsoftedge.microsoft.com/addons/detail/amazon-q-github-issue-h/poghackjbfhejeppjaegbnblangjbmmc)

# ­ƒÆ¼ Support

Got questions? We've got answers! 

Get support through:
- [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/Amazon-Q-Developer/feedback-q-developer-for-github-app/issues/new/choose) - Share feedback or report issues
- [AWS re:Post](https://repost.aws/tags/TA0dcbVDP4QgWbj0696CFBXA/amazon-q-developer) - Connect with the community
- [AWS Support](https://aws.amazon.com/premiumsupport) - Available with an AWS support plan
- [Troubleshooting Guide](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazonq/latest/qdeveloper-ug/github-troubleshooting.html) - Common troubleshooting steps
